applyTo: "workspace/**/*.md,templates/**/*.md"
---

# Solution Workflow Instructions

Documents must separate:

- confirmed facts,
- assumptions,
- decisions,
- risks,
- open questions,
- recommendations,
- freeze/baseline status.

Requirement artifacts must be testable.

Architecture artifacts must be traceable to requirements or decisions.

ServiceNow artifacts must clearly define catalog, workflow, data/reference model, custom tables, integrations, security/access, reporting, notifications, and operational behavior.

Never store or expose secret values.
